description: Source code for QuicSimpleClientSession class implementation, part of the QUIC protocol client in Chromium project.

classes.name: QuicSimpleClientSession
classes.description: Implementation of a simple QUIC client session handling streams, web transport negotiation, and multi-port path migration.

methods.name: QuicSimpleClientSession
methods.description: Constructors initializing the client session with configuration, connection, network helper, server ID, crypto config, push promise index, and feature flags.

methods.name: CreateClientStream
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client stream.

methods.name: ShouldNegotiateWebTransport
methods.description: Determines if WebTransport should be negotiated based on feature flag.

methods.name: LocalHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Returns the level of HTTP datagram support based on WebTransport enablement.

methods.name: CreateContextForMultiPortPath
methods.description: Creates a context for multi-port path migration, including socket creation and address management.

methods.name: MigrateToMultiPortPath
methods.description: Performs path migration to a new multi-port path using the provided context.
